messages.author: 8d587ec0858ae795
messages.subject: Argument is of length zero
parts:
I have a Shiny app working with a data frame. Data-frame is like below:

Name  Gender  Frequency
John       M         45
Mary       F         32

My UI.R file has this widgets:

radioButtons("sex", "Sex:", c("Female", "Male"),
             selected = c("Female")),
             br(),
             textInput("searchText", "Search: ", "")

My server.R file has:

# reactive function
  getReactionDTResult <- reactive({
    return(list(
      text = input$searchText,
      sex = input$sex
    ))
  })

I need to search data-frame based on input name and sex and then return conditional result If 0 text "there are no..." If less than 3 "there are less than 3.." Else "there are x person"

I have created a calculation function:

# Plot results of dataframe search
getDTResult <- function(df, reaction){
  maintable <- df[[1]] \\df is a list and I extract my needed dataframe maintable
  sex = reaction$sex
  name = reaction$text
  maintable$Frekuenca <- as.numeric(as.character(maintable$Frequency))
  
  if (sex == "Female"){
    sex = "F"

g1 <- maintable %>% filter(Name == name, Sex == sex)

  if(g1$Frequency == 0)
    
  { text = "Not found" }
  
  else if(g1$Frequency <= 3)
    
  {text = "Less than 3"}
  
  else
   {text == g1$Frequency}
  }
  
  else {
   sex = "M"
    
    g1 <- maintable %>% filter(Name == name, Sex == sex)
    
    if(g1$Frequency == 0)
      
    { text = "Not found" }
    
    else if(g1$Frequency <= 3)
      
    {text = "Less than 3"}
    
    else
    {text == g1$Frequency }
  }
  return(text)
}

and I have a plotting function:

output$text <- renderText({print(getDTResult(localFrame, getReactionDTResult()))})
Something goes wrong and I get:

Error in if (g1$Frequency == 0) { : argument is of length zero
What to do?

Regards

messages.subject: Re: Argument is of length zero

if(g1$Frequency == 0)

is the wrong test for "not found", instead it should be if (nrow(g1) == 0).

g1$Frequency has nothing in it. That is why it cant compare since its null.
So make sure that you get what you want in a right way in g1$Frequency so that you can compare it.
